# observability.EvalDataset

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

An eval dataset: platform eval sets per agent, or an organization's own (feedback, manual items).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `observability.EvalDataset` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.eval.read` |

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the dataset was created (UTC). |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Dataset id. |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Dataset name (`assistant.v1`, `feedback`). |  |
| `targetIds` | yes | `none` | Agents the dataset evaluates. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization of a tenant dataset; null for platform datasets. |  |
| `version` | yes | `none` | Current dataset version (items are versioned). |  |
